properties.where: Winter range: steep south and west facing slopes with shrubs and old Douglas fir, below deep snow. Near Kamloops the studied range is below about 760 m. Winter range. Deep snow packs deer onto the warmest, steepest slopes. Still on winter range. First green grass shows on low south slopes late in the month.
properties.label: general pattern

properties.where: Spring migration: most migrants go to summer range in April and May, often about 50 km, on the same route every year. Some deer stay low all year. Fall migration: collared deer came back in October and November; one year nearly all were back by mid October. Snow and cold set the timing.
